intended_values: The spatial locus of common tangents to three disjoint convex sets is null — Alec Kriebel (2026). Resolves Conjecture 4 in OWR44/2008, p.2552 (source DOI 10.4171/OWR/2008/44): the spatial union of complete supporting-plane common tangent lines to three pairwise disjoint convex subsets of R3 has Lebesgue outer measure zero. Covers nonclosed, unbounded and all affine dimensions. The stronger Conjecture 3 is outside this result's scope. Published research note and verification package: https://zenodo.org/records/23127955. Two fresh independent AI whole-package adversarial reviews completed; extensive AI-assisted solving, drafting and verification. Unrefereed; no conventional external human peer review or formal proof certification claimed. Historical open provenance and bounded priority audit include the full 2024 geometric-transversals article; no exhaustive global-first priority certificate claimed. Accepted PR18: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/18.
